title: Longview World of Wonders

services.name: Exhibit Expansion Fund
services.desc: Funds from our community have been integral in advancing our mission and we are so grateful for your support. These donations help us update and build exhibits including our newest project, “The S.T.E.A.M. Train”. This exhibit offers interactive activities for kids to learn about the railroad industry through hands on play. Please consider a donation tonight to our exhibit expansion fund to help us bring more new and exciting projects to the kids of East Texas. blurb: At WOW we fit in while standing out from other museums. Longview World of Wonders started with a dream much like many civic enhancement projects seen throughout Longview. Research began in the late 1990’s to bring a children’s museum to Longview. Longview World of Wonders is building upon those research and marketing/feasibility studies conducted to make a vision into a reality.
